prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1331; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim number.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?
A: I was stopped at a red light on the main road in Pasadena, Texas, near a shopping plaza.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I always do.
Q: What happened next?
A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. The other car must have been going pretty fast, because my head snapped back and then forward.
Q: Did you get out of your vehicle right away?
A: No, I stayed in the car for a few minutes. My neck was already stiff and I felt dizzy.
Q: Did you speak with the other driver?
A: Yes, briefly. He said he looked down at his phone and didn't see the light change in time.
Q: When did you first notice pain or stiffness?
A: Within the hour, but by that evening the pain in my neck and upper shoulders was pretty bad. I have a headache too.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or been to an urgent care facility?
A: I went to urgent care the next morning. They said it looked like a neck strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to a physical therapist.
Q: Have you had any prior neck or back injuries?
A: No, nothing serious. I had some minor stiffness years ago after sleeping wrong, but nothing that required treatment.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?
A: Yes, turning my head to the left is hard, and I can't sit at my desk for long without discomfort.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I've been missing some work while I recover, and I'd like the claim handled as quickly as possible.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
